verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Status Pages are documented as giving stakeholders 'real-time insights into...the status of incident resolution' and letting users 'proactively and securely communicate real-time operational updates without context switching to other tools,' which matches giving non-responders visibility without joining the incident channel/war room. Post-Incident Reviews and Incident Workflows also support structured updates to teams. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms a subscribe/opt-in mechanism for stakeholders, nor is there independent/hands-on corroboration of stakeholders actually using status pages this way. Missing for 10: explicit subscription/notification mechanism for external stakeholders, and independent verification that non-technical stakeholders use this without war-room access.
